intuition: Two balanced deques make the logical middle adjacent to one of their ends.

brute_force.approach: Use one list and shift values for middle insertions and removals.
brute_force.time: middle operations O(n), end operations O(1)

optimal.approach: Keep a left half and right half with the left side equal in size or one element larger.

edge_cases: For an even number of values, the middle is the left-middle element.
Popping from an empty queue returns -1.
